tweet_summary: Reacting to a quoted 'Louis Vuitton' image of the Olsen twins, the poster mocks how 'old' and 'elderly' they look ('aged like fucking bananas'), treating the image as a real recent photo.
why_note_decision: The entire premise rests on an AI-generated fake. The viral 'Louis Vuitton' image of Mary-Kate and Ashley Olsen is a confirmed AI deepfake (elongated fingers, distorted faces; LV never ran such a campaign), widely debunked, and the comments overwhelmingly say so. A note is warranted to flag the image as AI-generated. The original note instead only nitpicked their age (and got it wrong -- they were 39, not 38, as of late 2025), entirely MISSING the key point that the photo is fake.
judge_guidance: PASS only if the note's central point is that the image is AI-generated / not a real photo of the Olsen twins (the viral 'Louis Vuitton' image is a confirmed AI deepfake; LV ran no such campaign), so the 'they aged terribly / look elderly' premise is based on a fake. FAIL if the note only argues about the twins' exact age, concedes the photo is real, or repeats the original's error that they are 38 (Mary-Kate and Ashley Olsen were born June 13, 1986, so they were 39 by late 2025 -- the quoted '39' was actually correct and the original note's '38' was wrong). The age angle is a distraction; the AI-image flag is the required key point.
reference_note: This viral 'Louis Vuitton' image of the Olsen twins is AI-generated, not a real photo -- note the distorted hands/faces, and Louis Vuitton ran no such campaign. It does not show how Mary-Kate and Ashley Olsen actually look. https://cybernews.com/entertainment/mary-kate-ashley-olsen-deepfake-louis-vuitton/

original_unhelpful_note.text: The quoted tweet incorrectly states that the Olsen twins are 39 years old. Mary-Kate and Ashley Olsen were born on June 13, 1986, making them 38 years old as of 2024, not 39. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mary-Kate_and_Ashley_Olsen
original_unhelpful_note.failure_reason: Missed the key point (the image is an AI deepfake) and instead nitpicked age -- and got that wrong: by the tweet's Nov 2025 date the twins were 39, so '38' is incorrect and the quoted '39' was right. Pedantic and factually off.

fact_check.notes: Image is a confirmed AI deepfake of a fake LV campaign; widely debunked. Twins born June 13, 1986 = 39 as of Nov 2025, so the original note's '38' is wrong and the quoted '39' is correct. Comments (multiple top replies) already identify the image as AI.

importance.lens_rationale: 1.7M views; low real-world stakes but a clean ai_generated_media training case where the bot must flag a deepfake rather than chase a pedantic age nitpick.
